testcase.name: no confirmed plan yields no reminders
reminders are returned in trigger order
a task without a due date produces no deadline reminder
once the review time has passed the daily reminder rolls to tomorrow
a deadline warning fires at 20_00 on the day before the due date
a segment that already started produces no start reminder
a segment whose task is no longer active produces no start reminder
a segment starting later today produces one start reminder at its exact start
a deadline whose warning moment has already passed produces no reminder
the daily review reminder always exists and lands at 20_30
a segment whose task is unknown produces no start reminder
